about: The stores of the one coverage manifest (https://factlot.com/coverage.json). Every coverage figure FactLot publishes, for each store, with the time it was computed and what it was computed from. Generated by scripts/site/gen-coverage.ts; the coverage page, factlot://coverage and registry_coverage state these figures and point here. Do not edit by hand.
answer_first: A tool call on api.factlot.com can reach the hosted registry only. Its figures are the ones that describe what you can query today.

stores.name: Hosted registry
stores.describes: The data the registry_* tools on api.factlot.com answer from: commercial, industrial and multifamily parcels in a precomputed pack.
stores.computed_from: the manifest of the registry pack (site/_data/hosted.json, written by scripts/site/gen-hosted.ts)

stores.name: FactLot record
stores.describes: The shared database behind the record site and the exchange. It holds more counties than the hosted registry. The registry_* tools do not answer from it yet.
stores.computed_from: GET https://czmyqwkauymguoznzpzr.supabase.co/functions/v1/app?op=stats (parcels shown to people), read by scripts/site/gen-coverage.ts --record

relation: The two stores overlap but are not the same data: they were loaded by different pipelines, with different inclusion rules, at different times. Neither figure is wrong; each describes its own store. They become one figure only when the registry tools answer from the record.
